# system.registerWizardPage

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.6.5</span></div>

Register a page in the model wizard

```lua
system.registerWizardPage(params)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `params` | table | yes | see the fields below |

Fields of `params`:

- `available` (function, optional): returns true when the page has to be shown (i.e. depending on the model type chosen on the first page)
- `init` (function, optional): handler called when the wizard is opened
- `build` (function, optional): handler called on page creation, it adds the page fields (form API)
- `wakeup` (function, optional): handler called at each loop while the page is displayed
- `event` (function, optional): handler called when an event is received, with category, value, x, y
- `paint` (function, optional): paint function
- `run` (function, optional): handler called when the wizard creates the model mixes, in the pages order (only the available pages)
- `index` (integer, optional): position of the page in the wizard, negative values count from the end (-1 is after the last page), default is -3 (before the channels review and model name pages)


## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
system.registerWizardPage({available=isPlane, build=buildPage, run=createMixes})
```
